newsitem.title: CHINA: People's Insurance makes $6.25 mln payout on ship.
newsitem.headline: People's Insurance makes $6.25 mln payout on ship.

text.p: A subsidiary of the People's Insurance Company of China paid $6.25 million to a Shenzhen shipping company for a vessel that sank last year, a People's Insurance official said on Thursday.

The Tianjin branch of People's Insurance Company of China Property (PICCP) made the payment to Shenzhen Ocean Transportation Shareholding Co, owner of the Ninghai, a bulk commodity vessel that sank in the Sea of Japan, an official of PICCP Tianjin told Reuters.
The ship sank while carrying 17,850 tonnes of rapeseed from Canada to Japan last year, the official said by telephone from the company's office in the northern city of Tianjin.
PICCP Tianjin provided all-risk insurance to the shipping company, the official said.
No crew members were injured in the incident, he added.
Of the total compensation, $6.0 million was for the vessel itself and the remainder for the cost of an attempted rescue, the official said.

PICC Property, one of state-run PICC's three subsidiaries and the largest property insurance company in China, reported 35 billion yuan in premiums last year. It paid 22.1 billion yuan in compensation.
